lyrics:
[Intro: sweeping piano glissando, strings, straight into the chorus]

[Chorus: two women in unison, lush and bright]
Look at her go
Silver hair and seventeen at the core
Every beat she ever knew comes back for more
Oh, she's the last one dancing
And the first one on the floor
Look at her, she's seventeen at the core

[Verse 1: softer, one voice leading, piano and bass]
The band's a little out of tune
It's someone's wedding, late in June
She leaves her handbag with her friend
And walks out on the floor

[Pre-Chorus: harmonies rise, drums build]
And you can see it, anyone can
The years step back and give her room

[Chorus: two women in unison, lush and bright]
Look at her go
Silver hair and seventeen at the core
Every beat she ever knew comes back for more
Oh, she's the last one dancing
And the first one on the floor
Look at her, she's seventeen at the core

[Verse 2: softer, the other voice leading]
She raised three kids and buried one
She's done what anyone has done
But there's a song, and here it comes
And nobody is tired any more

[Pre-Chorus: harmonies rise, drums build]
And you can see it, anyone can
The years step back and give her room

[Chorus: two women in unison, lush and bright]
Look at her go
Silver hair and seventeen at the core
Every beat she ever knew comes back for more
Oh, she's the last one dancing
And the first one on the floor
Look at her, she's seventeen at the core

[Outro: chorus melody on piano and strings, voices in harmony, fade]
Look at her go
Look at her go
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 101 BPM, 4/4, A major. A stately, gliding disco-pop tempo. Glowing and bittersweet.

VOICE: Two women singing mostly in unison, one voice bright and clear, the other warmer and deeper, so the blend shimmers. They split into harmony at the ends of phrases and climb very high together. Each takes one verse alone, softly. Layered many times in the chorus.

INSTRUMENTS: A grand piano with a sweeping downward glissando and rich, rolling chords. A string section playing high, sustained lines. A steady drum kit with a soft four-on-the-floor kick. A melodic, moving bass. Acoustic and electric rhythm guitars. Tubular bells and a tambourine. A bright synthesiser line doubling the strings.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, a piano glissando and strings. 0:10 The chorus first. 0:44 Verse 1. 1:06 Pre-chorus. 1:17 Chorus 2. 1:51 Verse 2. 2:13 Pre-chorus. 2:24 Chorus 3. 2:58 Outro, the chorus tune on piano and strings with the voices in harmony, fading out by 3:45.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Mid-1970s Swedish pop wall of sound: dense, bright and reverberant, with many layers of voices and pianos blended into one glowing mass.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The piano glissando into the first chorus.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The watcher in the original sees a girl and feels time passing. This watcher sees an old woman and sees the girl still in there. Verse 2 gives her a real life, in two lines.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Admiration, tenderness, uplift.
